description: Source code for bandwidth sampling and congestion control in QUIC protocol, including classes and functions for tracking bandwidth, packet acknowledgments, losses, and congestion events.

classes.name: SendTimeState
classes.description: Represents the send time and state information for a packet.

classes.name: MaxAckHeightTracker
classes.description: Tracks maximum acknowledgment height and manages aggregation epochs.

classes.name: BandwidthSampler
classes.description: Samples bandwidth, tracks packet acknowledgments, losses, and manages congestion control metrics.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the SendTimeState to an output stream.

methods.name: MaxAckHeightTracker::Update
methods.description: Updates the max acknowledgment height based on bandwidth estimates and packet acknowledgments.

methods.name: BandwidthSampler::BandwidthSampler
methods.description: Constructor for BandwidthSampler, initializes tracking variables.

methods.name: BandwidthSampler::EnableOverestimateAvoidance
methods.description: Enables overestimate avoidance feature in bandwidth sampling.

methods.name: BandwidthSampler::OnPacketSent
methods.description: Handles logic when a packet is sent, updates internal state.

methods.name: BandwidthSampler::OnPacketNeutered
methods.description: Handles removal of a packet from tracking.

methods.name: BandwidthSampler::OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Processes congestion events, including acknowledgments and losses.

methods.name: BandwidthSampler::OnAckEventEnd
methods.description: Finalizes acknowledgment event, updates acknowledgment height tracker.

methods.name: BandwidthSampler::ChooseA0Point
methods.description: Selects the appropriate A0 acknowledgment point for slope calculation.

methods.name: BandwidthSampler::SentPacketToSendTimeState
methods.description: Converts sent packet info to send time state.
